## Problem and change / 问题与改动

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation / 验证

List checks run and their results. For UI changes, include screenshots with personal information removed.

- [ ] Build and relevant tests pass, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] User-visible changes are reflected in both READMEs where needed.
- [ ] No personal settings, logs, credentials or build outputs are included.
